dsDescriptionValue.value:
The year in which the research stored in https://dataverse.nl/dataverse/stichtingring took place, from 1985 onwards can be found in the report number, with for example ‘P:1997001’ implying that this particular study took place in 1997. 
Interpretations of the most likely wood provenance and estimations of the number of missing sapwood rings, if included in the original research report, are based on the knowledge at the time and may be subject to later refinement.

publicationCitation.value: Smit, J.L. & E. Jansma, 1997. Gaten en geulen vol glaciale gegevens. In: Groenendijk, H.A., 1997. Op zoek naar de horizon; het landschap van Oost-Groningen en zijn bewoners tussen 8000 voor Chr. en 1000 na Chr. REGIO-PRojekt Uitgevers, Groningen, 170-181.

Jansma, E., 1995: RemembeRINGs. The Development and Application of Local and Regional Tree- Ring Chronologies of Oak for the Purposes of Archaeological and Historical Research in the Netherlands. PhD-thesis Amsterdam University. Nederlandse Archeologische Rapporten (NAR) 19.
